spans.s: अस्, m. (n., L.) a piece of waste or uncultivated land situated between cultivated fields, desert, bare soil, AV. vii, 115, 4; ŚBr. viii; ŚāṅkhBr.; Kauś.
(अम्), n. ‘a space not filled up, gap’, that which serves to fill up a gap, supplement (of a book &c.), additional hymn appended to the regular collection, Mn. iii, 232; MBh. i; VāyuP.; ŚivaP. &c.
a compendium, compilation (esp. of hymns and prayers), L.
pl. remainder, BhP. vi, 4, 15
sg. (in alg.) an insolvable problem, Gol.
obduracy, Lalit. xix, xxi
= वेधस् (Brahmā or Viṣṇu, W.), L.
defective, insufficient, BhP. i, vi.
and खिल्य॑ (accord. to some also ‘pasture-land’)
अस्, m. (= कील) a post, AV. x, 8, 4; TBr. iii, 7, 6, 19.
खिल—काण्ड n. ‘supplementary section’, N. of MaitrS. v and BṛĀrUp. v f.
खिल—क्षेत्र n. an uncultivated field, Hcar.
खिल—ग्रन्थ m. N. of wk.
खिल—पाठ m. (opposed to सूत्र-प्˚) a collective N. for Dhātup., Gaṇap., and Vārtt., Pāṇ. i, 3, 2, Kāś.
and खिल्य॑ (accord. to some also ‘pasture-land’)
अस्, m. a piece of waste or uncultivated land situated between cultivated fields, RV. x, 142, 3
a piece of rock in the earth, mass, heap, lump, RV. vi, 28, 2
(ifc.), ŚBr. xiv, 5, 4, 12.
fr. ˚ल, q.v.
खिली—कृ (ind.p. -कृत्य), to make vain or powerless, Śiś. ii, 34; Rājat.
खिली—कृत mfn. turned into a desert, devastated, made impassable, Ragh. xi, 14 and 87
made powerless, Daś. vii; MārkP.
खिली—भूत mfn. (anything) that has become a desert, abandoned, unfrequented (by gen.), Car. v, 12; Kum. ii, 45; Hcar.; Naiṣ. xvii, 37
frustrated, Śak. vi, 22.
